title: Guardian Angels 10 Euro Copper Coin Set Unc.
descriptionPlain: Your angels. Your faithful companions: Consisting of the angels Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Uriel, each coin in this full set is struck in Uncirculated quality. Buy these four talismanic coins for yourself or as a faithful companion for someone dear to you. By giving these coins, you communicate the message that while you cannot always be with this person, the angels will most definitely be there for them. These talismanic coins can give strength and luck to those who own them.Michael – The Protecting AngelThe angel Michael should protect, inspire and encourage you, providing wings for your imagination.Gabriel – The Revealing AngelGabriel, the bringer of good luck, will help his owner make the right decisions and find unexpected solutions. You will be astonished at what you are capable of doing!Raphael – The Healing AngelRaphael will help recuperate your vitality and foster your powers of self-healing. He is a blessing for your body and soul.Uriel – The Illuminating AngelUsed as a talisman, this coin helps those who possess it feel joy in life, providing energy and creativity, as the power of Uriel illuminates their faces.The Guardian Angels coins Michael, Gabriel, Raphael and Uriel will enrich the life of your soul and that of those to whom you offer them.
